factorial(n<f64>) => <f64>
  ├ 0 => 1
  └ n => n * factorial(n - 1).

n := 5
res := factorial(n)

samples := 1..=3
x-row := [1.0 | sample <- samples]
y-row := [2.0 | sample <- samples]
x := x-row'
y := y-row'
~trail := [x y]
new-row := ([7.0 8.0])
next-trail := matrix/vertcat(trail[2..=3,:], new-row)
trail = next-trail
trail[3,2]

x := (true ? | true => 1 | false => 2)
~a := x
a += 1
a

xs := [1 2]
y := [(x, true) | x <- xs]
y
